request.subject: UNIT:CULT:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a secret-society galleon: the hull becomes indigo-blue wood #4a43b5 with shade #372f8f and polished brass trim #c9a24a; the grey stone tower becomes a round polished brass dome with a small telescope; the red sails become pale cream #f3e7c4 sails, the big one with one indigo eye-in-a-spiral sign; the red pennants become small lanterns with bright green flames. Nothing red. Keep the ship shape, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
